name: careerreboot
description: Workspace convenience scripts. Each agent keeps its own package.json and dependencies.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix agents/career-ops install --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix agents/hiring-radar ci && npm --prefix agents/career-ops/web ci
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix agents/career-ops/web run typecheck && npm --prefix agents/career-ops/web test
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix agents/hiring-radar test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm --prefix agents/career-ops run lint && npm run test:web
scripts.graph: graphify update agents/hiring-radar && graphify update agents/career-ops/web/src
